hypothesis: Low persistent trading activity may carry a liquidity premium and less speculative overpricing, producing stronger subsequent cross-sectional returns.
scope: A-share unrestricted-float turnover proxy; not an exact replication of the paper. One year averages persistent activity instead of individual bursts; 252 chosen before outcomes without window search.
unique_change: Rank by minus arithmetic mean daily turnover over 252 market sessions through the signal date. Lower turnover ranks higher. No volatility, momentum or trend overlay.
source_contract: Read-only dwd_daily_basic daily turnover_rate, percent points (5 means 5%); source restricted to SH/SZ and frozen market calendar. Preserve original source_name and updated_at in snapshot. No enriched turnover, contemporary share table or numeric rescaling heuristic.
unit_evidence: https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=32 ; local volume / historical float_share identity: 2015 shares / float_share_in_10000 / 100, repaired 2016+ lots / float_share_in_10000. Sample-date median absolute errors ~0.000025 percentage point; enriched/source ratio ~100 in 2015 and ~1 in 2016+.
availability: Finite nonnegative daily observations only; missing stays missing, never forward-filled or zero-filled, zero is valid; at least 200 in fixed 252 market sessions. No last-252-observed compression. Stop with missing-score list rather than shrinking original opportunity pool.
point_in_time_limit: Historical daily fields reconstructed in current database, not an archived contemporaneous feed; updated_at is collection/reconstruction time, not signal-time availability proof.
opportunities: Exactly 191688 archived eligible events in 82 month-end cross-sections; preserve all 284837 broad-reference rows, frozen 40-market-session outcomes, entry/exit costs, unfilled cash and censoring. No new momentum, trend, industry or volatility-level filter; no rematching.
groups: Ten average-rank percentile bands with ties kept together. Highest score group selected; ordinary volatility and original momentum evaluated under the same opportunity/outcome contract.
comparisons: Original momentum is the unchanged gate baseline; also report paired difference from already-frozen low-idiosyncratic ranking without blending or selecting either after results.

statistics.weighting: equal signal months, equal allocations within group

reports: All ten groups and Rank IC
Paired improvement versus momentum and frozen low-idiosyncratic ranking
Unfilled cash, censored and stale marks, zero-recovery sensitivity
pass_action: Retain only as training candidate; proceed to executable portfolio turnover/drawdown and costs before qualification. Reused training sample is not independent confirmation.
fail_action: Stop this representation and window, percentile, holding-period and overlay neighbors. Do not reverse direction or choose a better group after results. Move to a distinct mechanism.
